name: io.github.jxoesneon/ultranix-mcp
description: Secure Linux desktop automation - input, screen/OCR/vision, AT-SPI2 UI tree, window, clipboard
title: ultranix-mcp

environmentVariables.name: ULTRANIX_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key(s) (uxcp_*) for HTTP transport auth - required for --transport http (fail-closed), unused on stdio

environmentVariables.name: ULTRANIX_MCP_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a 0600 file holding uxcp_* keys, one per line

environmentVariables.name: ULTRANIX_MCP_API_KEY_EXPIRES
environmentVariables.description: Optional RFC 3339 expiry for the env-sourced key (self-revoking)

environmentVariables.name: ULTRANIX_MCP_HISTORY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: AES-256-GCM secret for encrypted action history (per-install generated if unset)

environmentVariables.name: ULTRANIX_MCP_SENTRY_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Sentry DSN for error reporting (unset = disabled)

environmentVariables.name: ULTRANIX_MCP_AUDIT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for audit.jsonl lines (tamper evidence for SIEM ingestion)
